Class ChunkLoader

java.lang.Object
com.mygame.terrain.ChunkLoader
public final class ChunkLoader extends Object
Streams terrain chunks around the camera, generating mesh data asynchronously and installing scene-graph objects on the render thread. At most maxChunksPerFrame chunks are assembled per frame.

Grass is generated on demand only for chunks within grass.distance; sampled terrain heights are retained so grass can be released when the camera moves away and regenerated deterministically when it returns.

      public ChunkLoader(com.jme3.scene.Node terrainNode, com.jme3.renderer.Camera camera, com.jme3.material.Material material, com.jme3.material.Material grassMaterial, com.jme3.material.Material rockMaterial, com.jme3.material.Material barkMaterial, com.jme3.material.Material leavesMaterial, TerrainGenerator generator, GameConfig config)
      Creates the worker pool and loader for the supplied terrain scene and validated settings.
      Parameters:
      terrainNode - parent node for loaded chunk geometry
      camera - camera used to choose nearby chunks
      material - terrain material
      grassMaterial - grass material
      rockMaterial - rock material
      barkMaterial - tree trunk and branch material
      leavesMaterial - foliage material
      generator - seeded terrain generator
      config - runtime settings controlling streaming and geometry
